segments.t: Back in the kitchen, Katya approaches Denis and announces that Kostya told her the whole secret. Before Denis can figure out why she wants to rent an apartment for the three of them, Chef Barinov calls him back to his station.
Почему ты сам мне не рассказал?
Ты бы знала, сколько раз я пытался.
Неужели ты думал, что меня это испугает?
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Hi, Denis, I know everything.' Katya brings out the contrast between 'hello' and 'Denis' in a few short words. Denis answers right away.
'In what sense?' Denis anchors the line on 'sense', while 'sense' completes the thought.
'Well, Kostya told me.' The grammar packs 'come on' and 'told' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'I see.' The meaning hinges on 'understood' working together with 'understood' in spoken Russian. Katya answers right away.
Почему ты сам мне не рассказал?
'Why did you not tell me yourself?' Katya brings out the contrast between 'why' and 'you' in a few short words.
Ты бы знала, сколько раз я пытался.
'If only you knew how many times I tried.' The '-l' ending on the verb meaning 'tried' places the action in the masculine past tense.
Неужели ты думал, что меня это испугает?
'Did you really think that this would scare me?' In Russian, the idea of 'really' flows naturally into 'will scare' without extra filler words.
'Do not worry.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'you' before landing on 'to worry'.
'We will cope with all the difficulties.' In Russian, the idea of 'we' flows naturally into 'difficulties' without extra filler words.
'We will rent an apartment.' Katya anchors the line on 'we', while 'apartment' completes the thought.
'The three of us will live together.' The grammar packs 'will' and 'the three of us' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Denis, I need fresh bread!' The meaning hinges on 'Denis' working together with 'bread' in spoken Russian. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.

Ты бы знала, сколько раз я пытался.
Неужели ты думал, что меня это испугает?
Completely baffled by Katya's talk of living together as three, Denis heads off to confront Kostya about what story he told her. See you in the next scene.
